title: Refuse and Recyclable Material Collectors
description: Collect and dump refuse or recyclable materials from containers into truck. May drive truck.

tasks.text: Inspect trucks prior to beginning routes to ensure safe operating condition.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Vehicle inspection is physical on-site work

tasks.text: Drive trucks, following established routes, through residential streets or alleys or through business or industrial areas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on vehicle and equipment operation

dwas.name: Operate vehicles or material-moving equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Refuel trucks or add other fluids, such as oil or brake fluid.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical vehicle maintenance work

dwas.name: Maintain vehicles in good working condition.

tasks.text: Dump refuse or recyclable materials at disposal sites.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical disposal of trash and waste

dwas.name: Dispose of trash or waste materials.

tasks.rationale: text generation — Draft incident reports; human verifies facts and liability

tasks.text: Operate automated or semi-automated hoisting devices that raise refuse bins and dump contents into openings in truck bodies.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crane/hoist operation demands real-time physical control

dwas.name: Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Dismount garbage trucks to collect garbage and remount trucks to ride to the next collection point.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Climbing ladders requires physical balance

dwas.name: Climb ladders or vehicles to perform duties.

tasks.text: Operate equipment that compresses collected refuse.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical operation of packing/material processing machinery

dwas.name: Operate packing or other material processing equipment.

tasks.text: Communicate with dispatchers concerning delays, unsafe sites, accidents, equipment breakdowns, or other maintenance problems.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Reporting malfunctions is structured information relay

dwas.name: Report vehicle or equipment malfunctions.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

dwas.name: Notify others of emergencies, problems, or hazards.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Check road or weather conditions to determine how routes will be affected.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Work conditions require physical site assessment

dwas.name: Gather information about work conditions or locations.

tasks.text: Clean trucks or compactor bodies after routes have been completed.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on washing of vehicle surfaces and parts

tasks.text: Tag garbage or recycling containers to inform customers of problems, such as excess garbage or inclusion of items that are not permitted.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI explains policies; human handles live questions

dwas.name: Explain regulations, policies, or procedures.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Make special pickups of recyclable materials, such as food scraps, used oil, discarded computers, or other electronic items.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lifting and loading of shipments
decision support — Algorithmic scheduling with human oversight of constraints
